nodes.Name: EINTR
nodes.DocComment:
Test various operations when a signal handler is installed without
the SA_RESTART flag. This tests that the os and net APIs handle EINTR.

nodes.Name: spin
nodes.DocComment:
spin does CPU bound spinning and allocating for a millisecond,
to get a SIGURG.
